message.content: I am eager to bring my four years of experience with pandas and scikit-learn to the Data Analyst role at your mid-sized logistics company. My work building a customer churn model — which reduced false-positive alerts by 18% over six months — demonstrates my ability to develop practical analytics that improve business outcomes. I also led a team of three, coordinating efforts to deliver results efficiently. Although I have used SQL occasionally and have not built a dashboard, I remain committed to applying my data science expertise to support your analytics needs.
